basic_info.description: Located in the heart of the Excelsior, this home has been in the same family for over 50 years.  The banana yellow facade is recent but wait until you walk up the terrazzo stairs.  Inside there are two full bedrooms, and a bonus room (often used as a bedroom or office) that looks over the backyard.    There is nothing more gorgeous that beautiful wood floors.  This home has beautifully redone softwood floors with amazing natural details.  Which means, when you visit, you're gonna need to take off those high heel shoes!    The formal living room has bay windows that look north and has amazing view from City College across to Sutro Tower.  The dining room is big enough for that 12 person full-sized dining room table... and did I mention the gorgeous floors?    The eat-in kitchen has a step-down pantry and is super-bright with lots of windows and it's going to be a great project for the buyer with imagination.    Out back is a full-width backyard that just says - opportunity!    Downstairs is a full depth garage big enough for several vehicles and LOTS of storage.
